newsitem.title: USA: Vion gains U.S. patent on hepatitis B drug.
newsitem.headline: Vion gains U.S. patent on hepatitis B drug.

text.p: Vion Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it received a U.S. patent covering a compound for treating hepatitis B viral infection.

The patent, for a compound known as L-2', 3'-didehydro- dideoxy-5-florocytidine nucleoside analog, was issued by the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office. It is assigned to Yale University and exclusively licensed to Vion, the company said.
The compound shows potent inhibition against the replication of the hepatitis B virus in combination with very low toxicity to host cells, such animal or human tissue.
VION is a biopharmaceutical company specializing in oncology and antiviral products.
